title: console: the Setup → Positions list has no Description column, so a position's description is served but never shown (hotcrm#2249)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 岗位的 `description` 已随元数据返回，但 Setup → Positions 列表没有「描述」列，管理员看不到。
- **要做：** 在 console 的岗位列表加一列 Description，和旁边的权限集列表一样。
- **完成标准：** 声明了描述的岗位在列表里显示它，没声明的显示为空。

Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`), as the platform half that objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2249 still needs. The governing text is the maintainer's 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (2026-10-18, hotcrm ledger `6245607810`), the order objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194 adopted (ruling `6354968262`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → Positions, the system administrator.
- **Served:** on `@objectstack/*` 18.1.0, `GET /api/v1/meta/position?include=grants` returns all 12 HotCRM positions with their `description`. HotCRM PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2280 adds them.
- **Shown:** the installed `@objectstack/console` 18.1.0 bundle declares only Name, Label, Holders and Permission sets on the position list. The permission-set list next to it does have a Description column. objectstack-ai/objectstack#25333 / objectstack-ai/objectstack#25369 added holders and sets, not descriptions.
- **Not measured:** the position detail page. No browser was available on the measuring rig, so the list reading is from the bundle.

## Done when

- The Setup → Positions list has a Description column that shows `position.description`.
- When the translation bundle's `positions` namespace (objectstack-ai/objectstack#25652) carries a description, the column shows the translated text, like the label.

**Size:** S. **Grade:** `priority:p3`.

## Dedupe

Method: every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue updated since 2026-10-15 (any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint and matched case-insensitively on `position`, at 2026-10-25T04:30Z. 12 hits. objectstack-ai/objectstack#25333 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#25369 are the holders/sets half (closed). objectstack-ai/objectstack#25652 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#25701 are translation (closed; merged 2026-10-24T21:55Z, after 18.1.0). None covers a description column. **New.**
